query: SELECT performance_on_hotpotqa, evaluation_dataset, multi_turn_retrieval FROM cspaper WHERE evaluation_dataset != 'Custom Agriculture Dataset (USA, Brazil, India); Washington state benchmark dataset' AND uses_knowledge_graph != 'Yes' AND agent_framework = 'CoT' AND generator_model = 'Llama2-13B-Chat';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: evaluation_dataset <> 'Custom Agriculture Dataset (USA, Brazil, India); Washington state benchmark dataset' AND uses_knowledge_graph <> 'Yes' AND agent_framework = 'CoT' AND generator_model = 'Llama2-13B-Chat'
